intro: An executive assistant resume that shows whose time you managed, at what scale, and how you made their work run smoothly.
tips: Say who you supported: titles and how many.
Show scale: calendars, travel, events, budgets.
Highlight discretion, judgement and the projects you ran.

basics.name: Isabelle Dupont
basics.label: Executive Assistant
basics.summary: Executive assistant with nine years supporting chief executives in fast-moving companies. I keep calendars sane, decisions moving and confidential matters confidential. Bilingual French and English.

work.name: Lumière Group
highlights: Manage the CEO's calendar, travel and correspondence across 12 countries.
Organise quarterly board meetings and an annual leadership offsite for 80 people.
Run the CEO's office budget and coordinate three other assistants.

work.name: Banque Ardent
highlights: Supported two managing directors in corporate finance.
